title: Planning guidance when an ordinary power calculation is not valid
summary: Executable R and Python templates that carry precision, fixed-design, rule-of-thumb, bespoke-simulation and not-applicable routes into code without fabricating a sample size.
pinned_defaults: No numeric sample size or power is returned unless a validated route-specific calculator is supplied.
Every record states why ordinary power is invalid, the inputs still needed, and the next action.
A bespoke simulation must report its seed, attempted replicates, successful fits, failed fits, estimated power and Monte Carlo standard error.
A fixed dataset is assessed with attainable precision or a prespecified minimum detectable effect, never retrospective observed power.
A rule of thumb is a floor and never the final recommendation when an effect- or precision-based method is available.
